limitations: the available profile is degraded and cannot serve as a healthy real-history performance sample

the first-page renderer request duration is an observed startup wait, not a session-switch latency statistic; the current trace does not isolate where the 14.24-second wait occurred
the PKG was expanded and its payload launched under an isolated identity; the PKG was not installed
the temporary app instance was closed after inspection; stderr showed repeated source-backfill failures while the degraded clone was running
